Round-2 harvesting notes
======================

Applied lessons learned from round 1:
- Prefer primary-source code or documentation pages over cached search-result snippets.
- Preserve explicit filter semantics like exact-value relations, confidence thresholds, and target-type constraints when they are visible in the source SQL.
- Keep this second pass separate from the first `web_scrape` corpus so promotion, deduplication, and quality review remain auditable.
- Allow simple query-library constants as source material, but treat them as lower-priority promotion candidates than richer join/filter examples.

Promotion updates
-----------------
- Promoted into executable `web_scrape_hq`: `leelasd_approved_drugs_with_indications`
- Promoted into executable `web_scrape_large`: `chembl_multitask_single_protein_nM_bioactivities`
- Kept the count-style query-library constants as source material only.
